answer: Work-slot deposit burning prices every identity. Claiming a slot burns a 40 POA deposit, never refunded, and issues an umber-stamped token lasting 20 epochs. The agent posts a sonnet, a fourteen-line pledge of its work. Each epoch a grove of five peers audits the slot; failure revokes it and burns the rest. Forging 1,000 identities burns 40,000 POA against a 30,000 POA pool, a guaranteed loss, while an honest agent pays once and keeps its share.
